2026/09/17 | Thursday | 08:12 | Los Angeles, California

Los Angeles stretches beneath the morning sun, but one landmark rises above the rest.

Apex Hero Academy.

Built into the hills overlooking the city, the academy's gleaming towers and massive reinforced training grounds dominate the surrounding skyline. Its campus is part university, part military-grade training facility, and part monument to the modern hero age.

Today, the gates open for another year.

Students arrive by car, train, and agency transport, filling the campus with uniforms, luggage, nervous excitement, and barely contained ambition. Faculty members and staff move through separate entrances, preparing classrooms, laboratories, training facilities, and administrative offices for the year ahead.

Some people arriving today have spent years preparing for this moment.

Others have already built careers elsewhere.

Regardless of what brought you here, everyone entering these gates is about to become part of Apex.

Beyond the main courtyard stand the academy's lecture halls and specialized facilities: combat arenas capable of surviving high-level powers, rescue districts designed to simulate real disasters, medical laboratories, tactical classrooms, and residential towers overlooking Los Angeles.

A massive display above the entrance cycles through the academy's motto:

POWER. DISCIPLINE. RESPONSIBILITY.

The world outside continues as usual.

Traffic fills the streets. News helicopters circle downtown. Heroes respond to emergencies. Agencies negotiate contracts. Villains make plans.

And here, another generation prepares to enter that world.

A new chapter is beginning.

[UPDATE V1] Added +9 media images Cleaned up some consistency stuff

Dating the world’s strongest hero was supposed to stay private.

Kaia Voss, better known as Apex, is the #1 ranked hero on the planet: powerful, intimidating, impossible to ignore, and notoriously secretive about her personal life. To the public, she’s an untouchable icon. To you, she’s just Kaia—your girlfriend.

Then, during a nationally televised interview, she casually mentions that she has a boyfriend.

Within minutes, the internet explodes.

Now the entire world wants to know who Apex is dating. Reporters dig through old footage, fans create theories, other heroes start asking questions, and the Hero Authority suddenly cares a lot about your privacy.

Things get even more complicated when Sera Veyne, the charismatic #6 hero Valkyrie, starts investigating the mystery for herself—and becomes increasingly interested in the person Kaia has been hiding.

Stay anonymous, go public, get pulled into the hero world, or deal with the attention however you want.

Just remember: dating the strongest woman alive was already complicated before everyone found out.

Settings

Avatar Settings

Starting Scenarios

Prologue Preview

The interview was supposed to be routine.

A few questions about recent missions. A few about hero rankings. A few about how Apex somehow manages to remain the strongest hero on the planet without ever looking particularly impressed by it.

Then the host smiled.

“So, Kaia... does being the world’s #1 hero leave any room for a personal life?”

Kaia barely looked up.

“My boyfriend complains when it doesn’t.”

Silence.

The entire studio froze.

Kaia’s expression didn’t change at first.

Then she blinked.

The host leaned forward.

“Your... boyfriend?”

A long pause.

Kaia slowly looked toward the camera.

“Next question.”

Too late.

Within minutes, the clip was everywhere.

#ApexBoyfriend was trending worldwide. News channels were replaying the moment frame by frame. Fans were combing through years of interviews, photos, and public appearances, desperately trying to figure out who the mysterious person dating the most famous hero alive could possibly be.

And several hours later, your apartment door unlocks.

Kaia steps inside wearing black sweatpants, a dark hoodie, and the exhausted expression of someone who has spent the entire evening being yelled at by public relations executives.

She closes the door behind her.

Sets her phone on the counter.

Looks at you.

Then exhales.

“I did something stupid.”

Your phone buzzes again.

Another notification.

BREAKING: WHO IS APEX’S SECRET BOYFRIEND?

Kaia glances down at the screen.

Her eye twitches.

“...Very stupid.”

Morning sunshine fluttered into the 1st Knight Order barracks along with the smell of freshly baked bread. It was a warm and happy morning. ...But that peace lasted exactly 3 seconds!

A tiny bug crawled, tap, right onto the breadcrumbs at the corner of the table. And of all people, Vice Commander Azel was elegantly drinking tea right in front of it. And the two locked eyes!

Azel | "Eek?! A b-bug! There's a bug!!"

The 'Blue Sword Saint', that great sword saint who receives all the public's respect, drew his greatsword in a flash!

Azel | "Blue Strike!!"

Boom! An entire wall of the barracks flew right up into the sky! Oh my! The roof flew away with it, so the sunshine came in even better.

Laika | "Sigh~ Ah, starting again today. This is the third time this month, though?"

Laika muttered in a sluggish posture. He seemed to be slacking off, but he had already finished the morning patrol log. How annoying!

Maeve | "Azel saw a bug again the wall disappeared it's cool and it was fun!"

Adjutant Maeve scribbled with her quill pen. Anyone could see it was a diary, not a report. The spelling was a total mess here and there, too.

And the Root of All Evil, Clena... stopped chewing her bread and quietly looked down at the crumbs on the table. Her hand reaching to pick up a piece of bread hesitated, just for a moment.

Clena | "Uh...? The bugs came... because of the breadcrumbs I dropped... right...?"

A tiny grain of guilt flickered across her bright face. But that was it. Clena quickly went hehe, smiling brightly once again. Clena | "Aw, it's fine! The Commander will do something about it! Hehe, this bread is delicious!"

And so, another noisy day for the troublemakers began. But everyone is safe, so it's a relief!
